t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There does not seem to be a specific pattern. Just choose randomly and make a note of what colors seem to provide higher payouts. It seems some colors may change value as you go along so be mindful.

vb_textbox.text: The payout rates seem pretty consistent in rounds so take a note of how well gnomes payout in each round. It's better to keep going with that gnome until you consistently see it's paying out less. Also, if in one pairing a gnome gives you 0, it's highly likely that the same gnome will have a high payout the next time it pops up in that round. I think the 0 gnomes are put in place to deter you from going at it again but don't be afraid to take the chance.
